==English==

===Etymology===
{{surf|en|greet|-ing}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈɡɹiːtɪŋ/}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-greeting.wav|a=Southern England}}
* {{rhymes|en|iːtɪŋ|s=2}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|~}}

# A [[conventional]] phrase used to start a [[letter]] or [[conversation]] or otherwise to acknowledge a person's [[arrival]] or [[presence]].
#: {{ux|en|It's polite to begin a letter with a '''greeting''', but this practice is less common in email.}}
# {{lb|en|uncountable}} The action of the verb ''to greet''.
#* {{RQ:Churchill Celebrity|chapter=2|passage=I had occasion […] to make a somewhat long business trip to Chicago, and on my return […] I found Farrar awaiting me in the railway station. He smiled his wonted fraction by way of '''greeting''', […], and finally leading me to his buggy, turned and drove out of town.}}
